target.rawQueryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, rule || ': ' || coalesce(observed,'?') || ' vs ' || coalesce(threshold,'?') || ' -> ' || action AS text FROM judgements WHERE action <> 'started' ORDER BY at
target.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, rule || ': ' || coalesce(observed,'?') || ' vs ' || coalesce(threshold,'?') || ' -> ' || action AS text FROM judgements WHERE action <> 'started' ORDER BY at

target.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, name || ' set to ' || value AS text FROM (SELECT at, name, value, lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY at) AS prev FROM limits) WHERE prev IS NULL OR prev <> value ORDER BY at

panels.title: Cost per run against limits.usd_per_run
panels.description: Each line is one run's spend as it accrued. The dashed line is the limit in force at that moment — edit it on the ammit page and the line bends here.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT e.at*1000 AS time, r.name AS metric, sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.usd')) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run ORDER BY e.at) AS value FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind = 'spend' ORDER BY e.at
targets.queryText: SELECT e.at*1000 AS time, r.name AS metric, sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.usd')) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run ORDER BY e.at) AS value FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind = 'spend' ORDER BY e.at

targets.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.usd_per_run' ORDER BY at

targets.queryText: SELECT e.at*1000 AS time, r.name AS metric, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run ORDER BY e.at) AS value FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind = 'turn' ORDER BY e.at

panels.title: How long a run has been going, against timeouts.run
panels.description: A line that reaches the dashed one is a run ammit stopped — the annotation at that point says what it ran to stop it.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(e.at/60 AS INTEGER)*60000 AS time, r.name AS metric, max(e.at - r.started) AS value FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE r.started IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(e.at/60 AS INTEGER)*60000 AS time, r.name AS metric, max(e.at - r.started) AS value FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE r.started IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.run' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Silence between turns, against timeouts.turn
panels.description: The gap between one turn and the next, per agent. This is the chart the service exists for: a model call that never came back shows up here as a spike and nowhere else.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS metric, at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run, coalesce(agent,'') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE kind IN ('turn','session_start') AND run IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS metric, at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run, coalesce(agent,'') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE kind IN ('turn','session_start') AND run IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at

panels.title: What ammit did
panels.description: Every limit crossed, what it did about it, and what the command said back.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at*1000 AS at, scope, coalesce(subject,'') AS subject, rule, threshold, observed, action, coalesce(outcome,'') AS outcome FROM judgements ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
targets.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS at, scope, coalesce(subject,'') AS subject, rule, threshold, observed, action, coalesce(outcome,'') AS outcome FROM judgements ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT started*1000 AS started, name, coalesce(verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(finished, strftime('%s','now')) - started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes, ROUND(coalesce(usd,0),2) AS usd, coalesce(turns,0) AS turns, coalesce(summary,'') AS summary FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT started*1000 AS started, name, coalesce(verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(finished, strftime('%s','now')) - started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes, ROUND(coalesce(usd,0),2) AS usd, coalesce(turns,0) AS turns, coalesce(summary,'') AS summary FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50

targets.queryText: SELECT name, value, at*1000 AS changed FROM limits WHERE id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM limits GROUP BY name) ORDER BY name
